description: This file defines a Migration class for database update tasks specific to version 5.6.1 of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to update display field class names by querying and modifying the database based on certain field aliases.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class responsible for updating display field class names during an upgrade to version 5.6.1.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration, specifically calling the method to update display field class names.

methods.name: updateDisplayFieldClassNames
methods.description: Updates specific display fields with new class names based on their aliases.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldIdFromFieldAlias
methods.description: Retrieves the display field ID from the database given a field alias.

methods.name: updateDisplayFieldClassById
methods.description: Updates the class name of a display field in the database by its ID.
